nodes.text: paper cuts and the star key
She sees me in a hundred different ways while few else can hardly see me at all. I am her best friend and only a small part of me exists on your human plane of existence.
This thought record is far more tangible than a glimpse of me ever will be. This makes it hard for your kind to understand the complexities of our relationship.
I am music, light, shadow and color. She a bodily flesh rollercoaster of emotion.
short scene 1: Girl with Imaginary Friend.
A young woman is accompanied by her imaginary friend, strolling through a vacant lot. The Imaginary Friend is a cloud of colorful images and strange particle effects.
They stop near a stump, the young woman sits and takes a picture of her friend. He shyly retreats from her viewfinder.
Stay still, silly, I'm trying to take a picture of you.
The I.F. suddenly snaps into focus, a strange neon outline of a person.
She gets the picture she wants and smiles. He casually drifts about, setting down feet, landing on the ground.
The Young Woman is walking through an alleyway, graffiti being written on the walls all ghostly behind her.
She stops to turn and look at it. She follows the art as it sweeps past her, gets to one end of the wall, and then comes back, a different color painting on top of the rest.
A slight pull back shows her take it all in, as the wall goes back and forth, filled with color. She puts her hand up to the wall and slips in.
Hold on the wall after she's gone. The paint keeps coming, color laid over color, until the wall is mostly black and still wet.
The young woman is walking along a red-bricked wall covered in ivy. It reaches all around her, high into the sky.
She pulls out a key and inserts it into a metal door. Upon opening the door, she enters a giant walled park, overgrown and dark.
